findings.title: The no-existing-integration path skips the identity check
findings.body: When the installation callback arrives before a webhook has created the Integration row, this `DoesNotExist` branch advances the pipeline without comparing the OAuth-authenticated user to the installation sender. Since the comparison below only runs when an Integration already exists, the installation can complete without the validation this change is intended to enforce. Reject or defer this path until the sender identity can be verified.

findings.title: Use a stable GitHub user ID for the identity comparison
findings.body: This stores only the GitHub login for the later identity check, but logins are mutable and can become available to another account after a rename. If the original installer renames their account and another user claims the old login, that different user can satisfy the comparison against the stored webhook sender. Bind and compare GitHub's stable user ID instead.

findings.title: Missing sender metadata causes an uncaught KeyError
findings.body: This assumes every existing Integration has `metadata.sender.login`, but `build_integration` adds `sender` only when the pipeline state contains it. An existing integration without sender metadata therefore raises `KeyError` here and returns a server error instead of the intended invalid-installation response. Treat missing sender data as a failed validation.
